features.detail: Library of emails, social posts, market commentaries, videos, blogs, e-books, lead generation and client engagement series, greeting cards. Browse categories: Email, Social, Video, Lead Generation, Greeting Cards. Compliance page states "All content is FINRA-reviewed". Use as-is or edit; editing sends it back through review.
features.limits_or_cost: All Marketing Suite tiers; depth varies by tier. Total piece count not published (Trustpilot profile claims 400+ pieces and 200+ added monthly, unverified).
features.notable: Library usage is the fast lane: pre-reviewed content skips the review queue. Vendor reports library email usage up 44% (2021-2022).

features.detail: In-house team publishes ready-to-send content on breaking market or Fed news "Within 48 hours"; Do It For Me customers get breaking-news emails "within hours of major market events".
features.notable: Pre-approved timely content is what advisors cannot produce themselves fast enough under review rules.

features.detail: Updating a website page or creating a new email sends it automatically to the compliance department's inbox; "When they hit 'approve' the content goes live." Compliance dashboard shows submission status, submission history and current activities; content can be created and approved weeks or months ahead of send date. Emails, social posts and website updates share one dashboard showing upcoming vs awaiting approval.
features.limits_or_cost: Specific status labels and BD integrations not published.
features.notable: Approval is the publish trigger, so nothing waits on the advisor after sign-off.

features.feature: Social posts routed to broker-dealer, auto-posted on approval
features.detail: Where applicable the system routes social content to the broker-dealer, captures when the piece is approved, and posts it upon approval or at the time the user scheduled. Networks: LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter/X.
features.notable: Schedule time and approval time are decoupled: post goes out at the later of the two.

features.detail: While the advisor drafts, flags "potentially risky language before submission" with guidance aligned to FINRA and SEC standards. Also checks Muse AI output (second compliance layer). Announced 2025-06-10; content comparison, policy risk scoring and one-click corrections announced as coming later in 2025 (shipping status unverified).
features.limits_or_cost: Firm-by-firm opt-in; firm must approve it as part of its compliance program; "may not be available at all firms".
features.notable: Pre-check before submission cuts reject cycles; planned risk score and one-click fix are the obvious next steps.

features.detail: "A few inputs" (tone, topic, goals) -> first drafts of emails, blog posts and social captions in the advisor's tone and voice, "ready for compliance review".
features.limits_or_cost: Marketing Suite Premium (USD 269/mo + 199 setup). Length options and caps not published.

features.detail: Conversational assistant inside the platform answering product how-to and marketing questions, with "a seamless connection to live help when needed".
features.notable: Escalation from bot to human support in the same thread.

features.detail: "AI-powered Curator" selects relevant articles from "thousands of articles from trusted sources" and generates custom captions for social. Learns the advisor's interests (hobbies, causes) to suggest more relevant content.
features.notable: Personal-interest signals (not just finance topics) make curated feeds feel less generic.

features.detail: Pre-made posts on many topics post automatically: "keeps your feed full and your profile active, week after week". Collection "Social Foundations" under Client Nurturing.
features.limits_or_cost: Included in Premium and Do It For Me; add-on for Essential.
features.notable: Autopilot posting from a pre-approved pool avoids per-post review.

features.detail: Pre-built collections: Market Insights (Weekly or Monthly newsletter, frequency customizable); Client Nurturing (Breaking Financial News, Seasonal Check-In & Referral, Social Foundations, Chart of the Month); Financial Know-How (Business Owner, College Planning, Cybersecurity & Scam Prevention, Life Insurance, Medicare, Social Security, Video of the Month); Life Stages (Ages 20-39, 40-54, 55-65, 66+); Celebrations (birthday and holiday eCards). Triggers: birthdays, holidays, age bracket, send frequency.
features.limits_or_cost: All automations included in Premium; otherwise collections cost extra.
features.notable: Segmenting by age bracket maps cleanly to insurance needs by life stage.

features.detail: Drag-and-drop wizard for emails and newsletters with sections, images, custom content and library articles; editable library gives a first draft to personalize. Contacts meter per plan (1,000 Essential, 2,000 Premium).
Customize social designs with Canva; pull stock images from Unsplash inside the builder.
Contacts sync bi-directionally with major CRMs daily.
eCards plus printed and handwritten-style notes and cards; Celebrations automation sends birthday and holiday cards.
"Omni-channel event promotion"; Do It For Me adds quarterly event ideas and a quarterly webinar promotion kit (slides, invitations, posts).
features.limits_or_cost: Premium and Do It For Me.

features.feature: Mobile app: share in one tap with compliance routing
features.detail: Pick content, choose audience, channels and tags, send. The app "automatically route[s] your post to get the green light from compliance before distributing it". Calendar shows scheduled, pending compliance and already sent; real-time analytics on opens and clicks.
features.notable: Three-state calendar (scheduled / pending compliance / sent) is a simple, clear status model.

features.detail: Dedicated Marketing Concierge runs the calendar. Monthly: 2-4 client/prospect emails, 5-8 social posts (LinkedIn, Instagram), 1 webinar or podcast outline, 1-2 SEO/AEO blogs, 1 video script, 1 marketing tip, breaking-news emails, 2 social assists per week (Mon, Wed), 2-4 COI emails. Quarterly referral email, webinar kit, niche campaigns, nurture sequences, welcome series. Advisor time: about 60 min onboarding (2 calls) then about 30 min/month to review and approve the calendar.
features.limits_or_cost: USD 895/mo + 499 setup. Excludes fully custom content, hard-CTA posts, website strategy, purchased lists.
features.notable: A fixed monthly quota per channel plus one 30-minute approval pass is a spec an AI agent could fill.

features.feature: Enterprise custom library pushed to advisors
features.detail: Firm publishes its own market commentaries, onboarding campaigns, emails, seminar kits, downloadables and ebooks into a firm library; advisors use it "with the click of a mouse". Compliance reviews content only when an advisor edits it; advisors need no separate compliance system.
features.notable: Edit-triggered review: untouched firm content skips review, edits go to review.

features.detail: Collect and display Google Reviews, testimonials, referrals, client feedback and surveys with compliance tools and CRM integrations.
Compliant texting product with scheduling, auto-responses, templates and integrations.

features.feature: Video library and video of the month
features.detail: Library includes video category (about 14 sample embeds visible); "Video of the Month" automation; Do It For Me adds monthly marketing tip videos and a video script.

features.feature: Monthly content drops filtered by persona
features.detail: Library adds 10 personal finance and 10 lifestyle articles per month plus 3 infographics and 1 quiz; filter by topic and persona. Recent additions sit at the top of the Content tab. Advisor can hand-pick or create own content.
features.notable: Lifestyle articles alongside finance content broaden the feed beyond product talk.

features.feature: Per-network share editor with preview control
features.detail: Share Content flow: add a message for the LinkedIn or Facebook post, tweet text, edit the preview title/image/description per network, select which Facebook Page to post to, preview, schedule "down to the minute" or post now, delete scheduled posts, drafts.

features.feature: Every share wraps a branded landing page
features.detail: Shared library content opens on an advisor-branded landing page with a Subscribe Form, featured sidebar, default logo, scheduling link and content blocks. Visitors who subscribe become contacts.
features.notable: Turns every social share into a lead-capture surface instead of sending traffic to a third-party site.

features.detail: Template Design > Landing Page Template > Subscribe Form: edit Subscribe Details and Subscribe Success Message, toggle Subscribe Success Button, set Button Label and Button Link URL (hosted PDF, Calendly, webinar). Save, test as visitor.

Template Design > Content > FINRA BrokerCheck: toggle "Display BrokerCheck?", enter CRD#, choose Type (Firm or Individual), Save / Undo Edits. Adds a button linking to the BrokerCheck profile on every landing page (FINRA Rule 2210). Falls back to the BrokerCheck search page if no profile.
features.notable: A regulator-required disclosure baked into the template so advisors cannot forget it. MAS analogue: representative register / licence number.

features.feature: WORM archive of social and landing pages
features.detail: "All landing pages and social content deployed through Lead Pilot will be archived to meet FINRA requirements", including form text and footer. Stored WORM (write once read many) for a minimum of 7 years. Emails and anything posted natively on the network are NOT archived; a BCC email archival option exists for email.
features.notable: States plainly what is and is not archived.

features.detail: "Compliance PDF" icon in the Edit Draft, Scheduled Content or Shared Content side window downloads a PDF to send to the compliance officer.
features.notable: One-click review artifact for firms whose compliance team works from email.

features.detail: Each contact gets a score from 1 to 100 based on engagement with content, actions and time; updates in real time; tuned per account using the advisor's manual star ratings of contacts. Shown on the Contacts page.
features.notable: Advisor feedback (stars) trains the score.

features.detail: "Mini-biographies" of contacts from third-party public data: job histories and links to social networks and website, under Manage Contacts.

Campaigns > Curated Campaigns: pick a template from the topic list (segment-targeted, content pre-selected), Edit Details (landing page), Share Settings (where it posts), choose Day and Time, Save Changes, Start Campaign. Drip campaigns live under the Campaigns tab.

Templates: Simple Newsletter, Single Column Mostly Text, Modular, Modular Without Borders, Boxed-2-Column, plain text; customize look and footer; lists and segments; send to specific contacts; preview.
Insights Dashboard, Activity Feed, email opens and clicks, content filter.
Help articles: Creating and Managing Users/Teams; Inviting users for seats.
Redtail, Wealthbox (one-click import of clients and prospects, contact details shown in Lead Pilot), Riskalyze; Facebook Pixel on landing pages.
Machine learning finds, filters and curates third-party and original content for each advisor; content passes a "Robo-Compliance" filter. CEO cited about six hours a week saved (2016).
Tailors content sent to each contact based on their engagement patterns and preferences; automates distribution across email and social.
features.notable: Personalizes at the recipient level, not just the advisor level.

features.detail: "150+ Pre-Built Campaigns" launch across website, email, text and social in one click (e.g. 90-Day New Client Campaign, Retirement Success); FINRA-reviewed; edit text, images, layout or build DIY (Custom Campaign Builder on Grow).
features.limits_or_cost: Foundations: Birthday, Timely Update, Newsletter only; Grow adds lead gen, prospect engagement, events, video, market updates, partner content.

features.detail: "Built-In Archiving & Approval Workflows": route content for review, lock edits after approval, archive communications in-platform. SOC 2 Type 2.
features.notable: Lock-after-approval prevents silent edits to approved content.

features.detail: Live feed of engaged prospects "ranked by behavior and intent" with opportunity scoring and next-step prompts such as "Call this contact"; send a text or email directly from the recommendation.
features.notable: Analytics turned into a to-do list.

features.detail: "Ask Snappy AI" answers questions about setup, campaigns and activity. Suggested actions: "Review account readiness", "Find the right campaign", "Prioritize the next opportunity". Embedded mode interprets leads, sorts contacts into groups and campaigns within approved automations, drafts emails, landing pages and visuals. Initial read-only experience excludes contact PII; respects roles; "People remain responsible" for compliance decisions.
features.notable: Readiness check + goal-to-campaign matcher is a strong onboarding agent pattern.

features.detail: Drag-and-drop AI builders for emails, headlines and graphics ("Create full campaigns in minutes"); AI Email Builder in every plan.
New leads from website, ads or third-party tools are added to campaigns automatically and get a personalized reply within 5 minutes (vs industry 24-48 hours).

Two-way SMS with every inbound and outbound message archived; route messages for pre-approval and lock final versions; multi-step sequences (birthdays, appointments, reviews); triggers on downloads, clicks, form fills; syncs with Redtail, Wealthbox, Salesforce. Claims 97% open, 45% reply rates.
features.limits_or_cost: Included in Grow and up; a la carte USD 99/mo.

features.detail: "Mass create and publish for all your advisors": deploy campaigns, research and commentary on advisors' behalf to any subset by hierarchy, cohort or office group; firm templates and custom uploads; branding rules and control over which elements advisors can customize; pre-approval, review, archiving, email journaling; every action logged; user impersonation; adoption pipeline; reports by individual, cohort, campaign, channel.
features.limits_or_cost: Priced by advisor count, integrations, support; extra advisor workspace USD 99 (Grow) or 699 (Freedom360); admin seats USD 99/mo.
features.notable: Field-level lock on what advisors may edit, plus adoption dashboards to spot who needs coaching.

features.feature: Marketing Hub calendar and lead scores
features.detail: Interactive cross-channel calendar of published and scheduled campaigns; hover for title, click to edit dates or contact lists; "highly visual lead scores"; Insights on growth, engagement and nurture across email, text, social, website.

features.feature: Lead capture, auto-subscribe, popups, gated content
features.detail: Grow plans add Lead Capture + Auto-Subscribe (new opt-ins drop into nurture campaigns), website popups and gated content; Grow websites add an auto-publish blog scheduler and social posting for blogs.
Plans meter contacts and monthly email volume: Foundations 10k contacts / 20k emails; Grow 50k / 80k; Freedom360 100k / unlimited. Extra advisor workspaces and admin seats billed separately.
Done-for-you strategy and implementation, Smart Growth Suite strategy, Quarterly Business Review, dedicated success manager; AEO comes standard on Freedom360 websites.

Mobile and web Post Library with a "Recommended" filter ("Recommended for Your Audience"); each card shows networks, engagements count and release date. AI-powered "Netflix-style" recommendations deliver user-specific curated content; AI Recommendations suggest what, when and where to post based on audience, location and performance.
Home office campaigns let the field team automatically post approved content to their own social channels; notification "Dynamic Campaigns: Your post was just successfully shared".
features.notable: Agents opt in once, then approved posts land on their profiles without per-post effort.

features.feature: Content+ AI curation screened by lexicon
features.detail: AI curates top-performing content and adds it to the post library; content is screened against the firm's lexicon and automatically enters compliance workflows.
Creates on-brand posts; agents can also create compliant original and modified content with publishing tools.

For videos posted by agents/advisors: pre-trained ML model scans frames for inappropriate imagery (nudity, violence, disturbing content, rude gestures); auto-generated audio transcript plus body text, titles and caption files are checked for lexicon violations; compliance staff make the final approve/deny call. 2021: 53% of customers published 360,000+ videos.
features.notable: Video is the format compliance teams fear most; transcript-based lexicon checks make it reviewable.

features.detail: Pre-approval workflows, real-time alerts, supervision and approval trails, infraction resolution; Risk Meter and AI-powered alerts; automated workflow routing so supervisors see highest-risk items first; universal supervision and threaded archiving. Built for FINRA, SEC, IIROC, FCA, PRA, MiFID II. Claims up to 80% less time reviewing/pre-approving.
features.notable: Risk-ranked queue rather than first-in-first-out.

features.detail: Update advisor/agent profiles across all networks from one place, with suggested profiles and pre-review of profile changes.
Push notifications such as "Your LinkedIn post has 2 comments. Reply to them now."
features.notable: Engagement prompt tied to a specific post.

features.detail: Benchmark performance, audience insights with AI recommendations, program ROI reporting.
Text, voice and WhatsApp conversations in one platform with keyword monitoring, pre-approvals, templates, triggered campaigns, AI-powered replies, supervision dashboard and built-in archiving.
features.notable: WhatsApp supervision matters for Asian agents who sell on WhatsApp.

features.detail: Integrates with CRM, archive and other enterprise systems; adds sites and compliant texting as channels.
Inputs: existing content to rewrite, content to translate, or a request for new content -> rewritten text, translation into 10 languages, or new emails/social posts "in a matter of seconds".
features.limits_or_cost: All plans include the AI assistant.
features.notable: Translation matters for multilingual markets (e.g. English, Chinese, Malay).

features.feature: Compliance flow via compliance officer email
features.detail: On by default for Financial customers. After scheduling, choose "Send Campaign without Compliance" or enter the compliance officer's email to receive a PDF (remembered; admin can pre-fill and lock it). Campaign sits in pending on its date. Approval paths: officer replies to the PDF with approval language and Levitate detects it and moves pending -> scheduled, or user clicks "Approve Campaign" / "Mark as Approved". Blog: "Submit for Compliance". "Send me a copy" regenerates the PDF. Substantive edits after approval require re-approval.
features.limits_or_cost: Approval blocked after the send time passes: email 2-day grace, social posts none (red notice, click "Change" to re-date). Approval emails max 3 MB total.
features.notable: Reply-to-approve uses the reviewer's existing inbox; no login needed.

features.feature: BD / Super Admin library review statuses
features.detail: Broker-dealers (across many RIAs) and RIA Super Admins mark each library template Pre-Reviewed, Approved or Rejected. Standard users see only Approved or Pre-Reviewed items with a notation; Rejected items are hidden. "Reject Campaign" requires a reason (Citations, Content, Images, Other) plus a note; Levitate tracks rejection trends. Campaign owner gets an email with reviewer name and decision as the record. Fully approved campaigns can be rescheduled without resubmitting.
features.limits_or_cost: Enabled via Success Specialist. CSV export lacks a compliance status column.
features.notable: Rejected content disappears for agents; reason codes feed trend analysis.

features.detail: Ready-to-send FINRA-reviewed content in the library lets advisors skip some approval steps. Cetera RIAs: social content is read-only and goes through Cetera review.

features.feature: Send from own Outlook or Gmail
features.detail: Emails send from the advisor's existing provider (Outlook, Gmail, Office 365) with unlimited automations; claims 60%+ open and 10% reply rates vs about 20% for mass blasts.
features.notable: Personal-sender delivery feels 1:1, not newsletter.

features.detail: Review and approve personalized email and social content months in advance; drag, drop and schedule templates; Prestige adds a "Full custom content calendar".
Your text printed in a handwritten-style card, sent at scale (e.g. birthdays).
Send, receive and organize texts in-platform for reminders and appointment confirmations; dedicated phone number.
Client satisfaction surveys (Client Happiness Score); 5-star ratings turn into review requests in the same email; Google Review notifications and tailored responses from the dashboard.
features.notable: Only happy respondents are asked for public reviews.

features.feature: Email read tracking and opportunity board
features.detail: Real-time email performance per send (read tracking, views, replies) and an "opportunity board" for relationship nurturing; keep-in-touch reminders on key facts and dates per contact.
features.limits_or_cost: Reporting and analytics listed on Essential.

features.detail: Each account gets a Success Specialist for onboarding, strategy and quarterly planning sessions.

Essential / Preferred / Prestige. Preferred adds API integrations, custom surveys, AI blog creation, industry blog library, SSO; Prestige adds full custom content calendar. Websites: 20 / 30 / 100 pages; compliance workflow on Preferred website plan. Add-ons: Google Local Service Ads, Meta Ads.
features.limits_or_cost: No public prices; GetApp lists from US$349 (unverified).

features.detail: Gives advisors access to personalized content they can use as their own and share with clients; co-developed with Fresh Finance (enterprise content publisher for advisors). Feature details, compliance handling and pricing unverified (site blocked fetch).

Combines the organization's research, insights and thought leadership with curated third-party content tailored to each professional's market and interests; find, personalize and publish from one place.

features.feature: Aura AI captions in approved styles
features.detail: Aura AI drafts captions in approved styles that program owners define; professionals personalize them before posting.
features.notable: Home office defines the allowed caption styles; AI writes only inside them.

features.detail: Publishing is tied to approved content, administrative controls and review/approval workflows; centralized admin of users, content, programs and policies.
Tracks adoption, publishing activity, content performance and audience engagement (e.g. IBM 2x click-to-share ratio, Oracle 34,000+ shares).

Automatically captures posts, comments, direct messages, reactions, images, videos and metadata with conversation history and timestamps, in native format, to the Smarsh Platform or an existing archive. Listed platforms: LinkedIn, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, BombBomb, Facebook, TikTok, Vidyard, Vimeo, X, YouTube, Instagram (100+ channels overall). Built for SEC 17a-4, FINRA 3110/4511, FCA. 40+ million messages per day.
